newsitem.title: INDIA: HOCKEY-INDIRA GANDHI TOURNAMENT POSTPONED INDEFINITELY.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-INDIRA GANDHI TOURNAMENT POSTPONED INDEFINITELY.

text.p: Lack of sponsorship forced the Indian Hockey Federation (IHF) on Wednesday to postpone indefinitely the annual Indira Gandhi Gold Cup men's hockey tournament scheduled for next month.
An IHF spokesman said efforts were being made to find more sponsors before setting a new date for the tournament, which had been scheduled for February 3-11 in New Delhi.
